text: Kevin Park is the strongest candidate for Santa Clara mayor because he is the only one in this race who championed a Gaza ceasefire resolution on the City Council, a local act that his opponents Karen Hardy and Kathy Watanabe opposed. He was the councilmember who pushed for a ceasefire when the effort was blocked before introduction, and he backed a United Against Hate resolution alongside it. CAIR Action places him at its preferred tier for this race. Hardy and Watanabe both opposed the ceasefire call while supporting only a general anti-hate resolution that shields Israel from local accountability. Park's record of standing with the Muslim community when the council refused to act makes him the clear choice to carry that accountability into city government.

editorial_correction.reason: Remove the unsupported Israel-alignment inference caused by ICAN matching inside American, and an unsupported absolute absence claim. Scores and choice unchanged.
